findings.summary: Fixed concurrency serializes runs but the workflow has no github.run_attempt==1 gate. GitHub supports manual re-runs with the same GITHUB_SHA/GITHUB_REF, so a failed attempt before persistence can repeat the benchmark.
Top-level permissions are empty and only persist has contents:write, but actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-python@v5 are mutable major tags in the write-token job instead of full commit SHAs.
Both checkouts set persist-credentials:false, but the final step writes GITHUB_TOKEN into origin URL via git remote set-url until runner teardown.

Branch existence and tip==dispatch SHA are checked before push but not atomically with the ref update. If the branch is deleted after the final check, ordinary git push can recreate it; ref movement is not protected by expected-old-tip lease semantics. protected=false is also not rechecked immediately before push.
Only workflow_dispatch is declared; both jobs require refs/heads/main plus the exact confirmation token.
permissions:{} at workflow level; preflight contents:read; persist contents:write; unspecified scopes none.
Exactly four persisted paths are checked against full worktree and staged filename sets; no broad git add.
RESULT_BRANCH is fixed and the refspec is exactly HEAD:refs/heads/$RESULT_BRANCH with same-repository origin and no force push.

No upload/download-artifact, LFS, PAT, actions/cache, secrets.*, push/PR/schedule/repository_dispatch/workflow_call trigger. setup-python cache is not requested. GITHUB_TOKEN push does not recursively trigger ordinary push workflows.

recheck_if_r294_changes_workflow: PR head and workflow git blob
trigger set and both main-ref/confirmation guards
full-SHA pinning of every action in contents:write job
checkout credential persistence and later token insertion
fixed result branch and absence of dispatch-controlled branch input
branch existence/protection/rules/tip gates and atomic expected-old-tip push semantics
exact remote/refspec and no branch-creation/force behavior
any step added between final branch verification and push
